permission_type.desc: The type of permission that defines who can use this MCP server _Acceptable values:_ `everyone` `no_one` `named_entities` `named_entities_exclude`. When the `permission_type` field is set to `named_entities` or `named_entities_exclude`, pass either or both `user_ids` and `usergroup_ids` values to define the entities the rule applies to.

server_id.desc: Encoded ID of the MCP server

user_ids.desc: List of user IDs to set for named\_entities or named\_entities\_exclude. When the `permission_type` field is set to `named_entities` or `named_entities_exclude`, pass either or both `user_ids` and `usergroup_ids` values to define the entities the rule applies to.

usergroup_ids.desc: List of encoded usergroup IDs. When the `permission_type` field is set to `named_entities` or `named_entities_exclude`, pass either or both `user_ids` and `usergroup_ids` values to define the entities the rule applies to.

desc: Set the access control permission for who can use an MCP server
